campaign.title: Ignore tool caches and coverage artifacts
campaign.goal: Append missing tool cache and coverage ignore entries without changing existing rules
constraints: Only .gitignore changes; no workflows or template-synced files
definition_of_done: One ready PR per needed repository with add-only diff and effective-ignore proof

recipe.summary: Append only absent tool cache and coverage entries
recipe.command_template: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path('"'"'.gitignore'"'"'); s={line.removesuffix('"'"'\r'"'"') for line in p.read_bytes().decode('"'"'utf-8'"'"').split('"'"'\n'"'"')}; print('"'"'\n'"'"'.join(e for e in ['"'"'.mypy_cache/'"'"', '"'"'.pytest_cache/'"'"', '"'"'.ruff_cache/'"'"', '"'"'coverage.xml'"'"', '"'"'.coverage'"'"'] if e not in s))' --dry-run

acceptance: Only missing ignore lines are appended and existing content is preserved byte for byte
manual_review: Existing ignore exceptions stay present; normal machine checks and review-thread gates apply
delegate_prompt: Add only missing lines from .mypy_cache/, .pytest_cache/, .ruff_cache/, coverage.xml and .coverage to .gitignore. Never remove existing lines. Preserve original content byte for byte, append absent entries, and change no other file. Prove zero deleted lines with git diff --numstat and all five paths with git check-ignore --no-index; capture command output in one ready PR per source issue.
